description: This file defines the data model for 'Block' entities in the Focalboard server, including struct definitions, validation methods, and related types and functions.

classes.name: Block
classes.description: Represents a basic unit of data in the Focalboard system, including metadata such as ID, type, title, timestamps, and fields.

classes.name: BlockPatch
classes.description: Used to specify modifications to an existing Block, supporting partial updates.

classes.name: BlockPatchBatch
classes.description: A batch of block IDs and corresponding patches for bulk modifications.

methods.name: BlocksFromJSON
methods.description: Decodes JSON data from an io.Reader into a slice of Block pointers.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Validates a Block instance, checking for required fields and size constraints.

methods.name: LogClone
methods.description: Creates a lightweight clone of a Block for logging purposes.

methods.name: Patch
methods.description: Applies a BlockPatch to a Block, returning the updated Block.

methods.name: StampModificationMetadata
methods.description: Updates blocks with modification metadata such as user ID and timestamp, optionally recording audit info.

methods.name: ShouldBeLimited
methods.description: Determines if a block should be limited based on its type and update timestamp.

methods.name: GetLimited
methods.description: Returns a limited version of the block containing only IDs and type, omitting content.
